summary: Tested 3 new features: (a) seed demo integrity + analysis preview over CUG-001, (b) Batal Pencairan admin flow (API DELETE /api/pencairan/{id} + UI button+confirm), (c) Iuran-by-Petugas with CU scoping (petugas CU is fixed, cannot post/edit/delete/view other CUs). 21/21 backend pytest cases pass (new file /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py). Previous regression (test_tudung_api.py, 26 cases) still green. Frontend: logged in as admin on /bantuan-cair, selected pre-seeded batch, clicked 'batal-pencairan-btn', confirmed – pencairan removed, permohonan reverted to 'Sudah Dianalisis'. Logged in as petugas on /iuran: CU select is locked (shows petugas's CU only), add-rapel row works, Simpan Iuran saves 2 rows, edit changes a value, delete removes a row. All TEST_ CUs/users/permohonan/iuran cleaned up at the end; settings.nomor_berikutnya reset to 1. Seed data (6 CUG CUs x 9 permohonan = 54) left intact and un-analyzed.

issues: CU select shadcn Button has HTML `disabled=""` attribute but no `aria-disabled`; still visually and functionally locked. Minor a11y nit.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py batal_pencairan: correctly removes nomor_pencairan/pencairan_id/tanggal_cair via $unset and resets tunda_pencairan. However it does NOT roll back settings.nomor_berikutnya, so if a user batal + cairkan again the next auto-nomor increments past the released one. Low priority (admin can manually set).
server.py update_iuran line 691: check_cu runs on both the existing row (via _own_iuran) and body.cu_id, so petugas cannot repoint an iuran to another CU. Good.
Iuran.jsx line 46: when switching CU, `reset()` is called but previous rows list may still briefly flash. Harmless.
BantuanCair.jsx: after doBatal the local `cur` state is not cleared (next load() picks batches[0]). If the deleted batch was the only one, cur becomes null correctly. Fine.
seed_demo.py: idempotent via 'CUG-001 exists' guard — good. Does not create analyses, so seed CU-001 is safe to run analyze-preview against without side effects. Perfect for demo.
No DELETE for pencairan is now addressed – iteration_1's minor issue resolved.
seed_data_creation: All TEST_ data created (TEST_UI_CU, TEST_UI_CU2, test_ui_petugas_*, TEST_UIAnggota, TEST_BatalCU, TEST_IuranCU_A/B) was deleted at the end of each test. settings.nomor_berikutnya reset to 1. The 6 CUG-001..006 + 54 permohonan seed data left intact and un-analyzed as instructed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run both backend suites: cd /app && pytest backend/tests/ -v -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/results.xml. Seed demo (CUG-001..006 x 9) must remain un-analyzed; analysis preview is non-destructive. Server date assumed 2026-10-10 Asia/Jakarta. If testing petugas UI, the main app lands on '/' not '/dashboard' – wait for text 'Selamat datang' after login. Iuran CU-select for petugas is a shadcn Button rendered disabled (no native <select>), use data-testid='iuran-cu-select'.
